Behind the empty shelf, through a surreal atmospheric haze, looms the massive dark silhouette of a crude oil tanker ship, dramatically oversized, casting an ominous shadow over the entire store interior. Pure black background with cinematic rim lighting on the bag. The melting transition creates viscous dripping streams that glow with fiery orange light. Dramatic tension atmosphere with high contrast between the cool blue-green plastic and hot red-orange melted geography.
